rules.title: Prohibition on the Sale or Use of Coordinated Pricing Algorithms to Set Rents or Manage Occupancy Levels for Residential Dwelling Units
rules.requirement: Landlords and vendors in Berkeley may not use or sell software that coordinates pricing among competing landlords by sharing nonpublic data to set rent or occupancy levels.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley where a coordinated pricing algorithm uses nonpublic competitor data between one Berkeley landlord and competitors.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply to products that only publish aggregated/anonymous rental data without recommending prices, products used to set affordable housing rent/income limits, or certain market research/financing data uses.
rules.quoted_span:
This Chapter solely 
regulates the use and sale of the coordinated pricing algorithms, to prevent the harms 
described above.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is government-subsidized affordable housing with rent set under affordable housing guidelines (exempt)
